newsitem.title: USA: Maxxim Medical managers buy 400,000 shares.
newsitem.headline: Maxxim Medical managers buy 400,000 shares.

text.p: Maxxim Medical Inc said Friday that several memebers of senior management, including all of the company's officers, will purchase 400,000 shares of Maxxim common from the company at $13 per share.
The stock was trading late Frimday morning at 13-7/8.
The transaction, said the company, is valued at $5.2 million.
Maxxim said that the purchases will be financed with full recourse personal loans with each buyer personally responsible for any losses and for repayment of the loan when it comes due.

The company said that the purchases demonstrate management's overall confidence in the company's future. Maxxim, a diversified medical products manufacturer and supplier, had sales of $400 million in fiscal 1996, with earnings of $8.7 million, or $1.01 per share fully diluted.
